arts.name: The Seated Blade
arts.effect: Fight at full Might from a fixed position; no penalty for being unable to move.

arts.name: Iron Grip
arts.effect: Cannot be disarmed; advantage to bind and hold a blade.

arts.name: Hammerfall
arts.effect: One blow per fight that staggers whatever it lands on.

arts.name: Stillwater Stance
arts.effect: Advantage to keep footing; cannot be knocked down while braced.

arts.name: The Long Breath
arts.effect: Recover once per fight; endure where others tire.

arts.name: The Mender's Patience
arts.effect: +Rank to Resolve checks against fear, haste and temptation.

arts.name: Warden's Eye
arts.effect: Read a weakness or a lie; +Rank to Insight.

arts.name: Groundbreaker
arts.effect: Drive through a line; Might checks on foot gain +Rank.

arts.name: Soft Landing
arts.effect: Take falls and drops without harm.

arts.name: The Long Road
arts.effect: Travel and pursue without exhaustion.

arts.name: Thunderstep
arts.effect: Leap gaps, walls and horses.

arts.name: Hawk's Stoop
arts.effect: Close any distance before a bow can be drawn twice.

arts.name: Anchor
arts.effect: Stop dead at full speed; break a charge.

arts.name: The Turning Blade
arts.effect: Turn at speed and strike from the turn.

arts.name: The Quickening
arts.effect: Act before the enemy finishes deciding.

arts.name: The Measured Hand
arts.effect: Whatever he throws lands where he means it to, at the pace he means: a blade into a friend's palm, a stone that only taps the shutter. Advantage to place a thrown thing.

arts.name: The Wicket Gate
arts.effect: Thread a thrown or passed thing past a man standing in its way; a guard in the line stops it only if he wins a contest for it.

arts.name: The Liar's Shoulder
arts.effect: Sell a false intention with the body. Once per scene, a foe who reads him commits the wrong way: advantage on the next check against that foe.

arts.name: Overwall
arts.effect: Throw over a shield, a wall or a crowd and drop it into the space behind; what stands between him and the mark gives it no cover.

arts.name: The Far Cast
arts.effect: A long throw a running ally can take: the rope across the river, the sword across the hall, landing where the runner will be.

arts.name: Tell-Reading
arts.effect: Watch a foe's hips and hands and know his next move before he makes it. Once per scene, ask what an opponent means to do.

arts.name: The Shadow-Step
arts.effect: Mirror a foe and stay between him and what he wants: advantage to hold a doorway, cut off a flight, or shadow a duelist step for step.
